title: iOS remote bridge
responsibility: Provide the native iOS remote bridge, its camera pairing scan and protected cache.

outputs.name: bridge
outputs.description: The page-facing Capacitor bridge registered as HarnessRemote, exposing status, scan, disconnect, and request promises plus status and event notifications. Its channel, credential, keys, and saved copies stay in native code.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: A snapshot of connection state and public host, device, grant, reason, last-online time, and attached methods. It remains offline while the computer is away; eligible cached reads are returned by requests with cachedAt, and a known screen lock is included only while online.

examples.reason: The computer did not answer in time.

errors.name: permission-denied
errors.description: An unavailable method is rejected with method-denied; computer refusals with project-denied, agents-denied, method-denied, or not-attached purge the saved cache and fail waiting reads as superseded. A revoked refusal ends the pairing.

errors.name: uncertain
errors.description: When a link ends before a requested change is confirmed, the page receives an offline failure because the phone cannot know whether the computer ran it. The change is never sent again.

errors.name: scan-failure
errors.type: camera or offer refusal by its remoteScanFailures code; nothing is sent
errors.description: Camera denial, camera unavailability, cancellation, or an invalid, unsupported, disallowed-environment, or expired offer rejects scanning with its camera-denied, camera-unavailable, scan-cancelled, offer-invalid, offer-unsupported, offer-environment, or offer-expired code. An invalid device name is rejected as invalid-message before scanning starts.

errors.name: scan-ended
errors.type: Disconnect ends an open scan; a late camera answer begins no pairing
errors.description: Disconnect cancels an open camera scan and rejects it as scan-cancelled. Any later camera result is ignored and cannot begin pairing.

dependencies.contract: Secure-channel keys, counters and packet envelope
